$description: TwiceOver design tokens · canonical: stock-analyst-platform /ai-team/design/tokens/twiceover.tokens.json · v1.0.1 · 2026-06-19 — PATCH: read-surface tokens minted for the Ledger identity (#159). Adds accent-surface.* (the reserved Paths/Outlook pair standout — pale navy wash in light, navy-lift in dark; pair-symmetric per ADR 0008), surface.panel.* (the impersonal-half band), text.link.* (inline link/handle, kept distinct from accent.default per ADR 0008), typography.half-header + font.size.550 (the 'Your read / Ticker analysis' half-header slot), and motion.duration.reveal (220ms — the section-loader part-and-whoosh). All new tokens are app-only (outside themes.*). No structural rename; semver patch. v1.0.0 · 2026-06-19 — MAJOR: re-architected to the two-theme 'Ledger' identity (ADR 0035, Accepted 2026-06-19; theming architecture + contrast gate per consult 0067; ADR 0004 sync convention). Site-safe semantic tokens (bg/text/accent/border/focus) now live under themes.light (default) and themes.dark (variant) — the build emits themes.light → :root and themes.dark → [data-theme='dark']. Consumers still bind to the SAME emitted CSS custom-property names (--color-bg-canvas, --color-text-primary, …) which re-resolve per active theme; only the JSON path moved (the structural rename = the major bump). Theme-invariant tokens (font.*, typography.*, space.*, radius.*, motion.*) stay at root and emit once into :root. App-only tokens (signal.*/health.*/elevation.*/path-card.*) stay at root OUTSIDE themes.* — the site build never walks them (#34 containment, consult 0067 Q5); the ones whose contrast depends on the canvas carry .light/.dark sub-values (a single value cannot be AA on both ivory and graphite). Primitives (color.*) are inlined, never exposed, and may be re-tuned without notice. Sync convention: /ai-team/design/design-system.md

warm-white.$description: Light-theme paper ramp (warm ivory). 100 lightest. Light bg surfaces only.

300.$description: Warm ivory canvas — the brand paper (light bg.canvas).

250.$description: Light bg.inset (ADR 0340 Amdt 2, 2026-07-19) — the recessed step BELOW surface/raised: hover fills on outline controls, quiet inset note blocks. 1.14:1 vs raised / 1.09:1 vs surface — a hover-weight step, deliberately far shallower than the 1.48:1 jump these consumers got when they used bg.canvas as their fill. Near but NOT equal to surface.panel.light (#F2EEE4) — a distinct role, kept as its own step so a future panel retune can't silently move every hover state in the app (same non-coupling reasoning as surface.personal).

warm-graphite.$description: Dark-theme surface ramp (warm graphite, not cool black). 800 lightest → 900 darkest. Dark bg surfaces only.

820.$description: Dark bg.inset (ADR 0340 Amdt 2, 2026-07-19) — the dark counterpart of warm-white.250. NOTE the direction flip: in dark this step is LIGHTER than raised/surface, because dark elevation lifts rather than recesses (design-system.md's standing rule). 1.12:1 vs raised / 1.26:1 vs surface. This is the actual bug fix in dark, not just a softening — the consumers using bg.canvas here were DARKENING on hover (1.40:1 downward), the opposite of what dark elevation means.

warm-ink.$description: Shared warm neutral ramp for text + borders across BOTH themes. 100 lightest → 900 darkest. Light theme draws text from the dark end (900→600); dark theme from the light end (100→400). Intermediate stops carry decorative borders.

500.$description: border.interactive (both themes): ≥3:1 on every bg in light (3.68–4.08) and dark (3.54–4.38) per WCAG 1.4.11.

600.$description: Light text.muted — re-floored for warm paper (ADR 0035 corrects the #8A8378 3.4:1 defect). 5.34:1 on canvas — AA at any size.

750.$description: Dark border.default — warm hairline on graphite.

800.$description: Light text.long-form — softer ink for sustained reading.

900.$description: Light text.primary — warm near-black ink. 15.14:1 on canvas.

navy.$description: Light-theme accent (ink-navy). Same hue family as the dark steel accent; never a signal color. 500 lightest (hover) → 700 darkest (active). 050/100 are wash fills used by accent-surface tokens.

050.$description: Pale navy wash — pill fill (accent-surface.pill.light). Not emitted to site.

100.$description: Pale navy wash — section/box container fill (accent-surface.container.light). Not emitted to site.

500.$description: Light accent.hover. 6.89:1 on canvas — AA body text.

600.$description: Light accent.default + focus. 9.01:1 on canvas (AAA-near); as link text AA on every surface.

650.$description: Light text.link — brighter than accent.default, kept distinct per ADR 0008 so the reserved accent-surface standout is never confused with inline links. 7.41:1 on canvas — AA on every surface.

700.$description: Light accent.active — fills/borders on press only, not text.

steel.$description: Dark-theme accent (lifted steel). Same hue family as the light navy accent; never a signal color. 200/250 are wash fills used by accent-surface tokens. 300 lightest (hover) → 500 darkest (active).

200.$description: Navy-lift wash — pill fill (accent-surface.pill.dark). Not emitted to site.

250.$description: Navy-lift wash — section/box container fill (accent-surface.container.dark). Not emitted to site.

280.$description: Muted rule inside the accent container (accent-surface.rule.dark). Not emitted to site.

300.$description: Dark accent.hover / accent-surface marker + label. 9.12:1 on canvas — AA body text.

350.$description: Dark text.link — slightly distinct from accent.default per ADR 0008. 8.28:1 on canvas — AA on every surface.

400.$description: Dark accent.default + focus. 7.10:1 on canvas — AA body text on every surface.

500.$description: Dark accent.active — fills/borders on press only, not text.

green.$description: Primitives behind signal.positive, per theme. P&L gain — on the number only, always with an explicit sign.

light.$description: Light theme: deep green, AA on ivory (4.83:1 canvas → 5.35:1 raised).

dark.$description: Dark theme: bright green, AA on graphite (8.06:1 canvas → 6.52:1 raised).

red.$description: Primitives behind signal.negative, per theme. P&L loss — on the number only, always with an explicit sign.

light.$description: Light theme: deep brick red, AA on ivory (4.90:1 canvas → 5.43:1 raised).

dark.$description: Dark theme: bright red, AA on graphite (6.16:1 canvas → 4.98:1 raised).

amber.$description: Primitives behind health.degraded, per theme. Data-health marker — deliberately neither a signal hue nor the accent.

light.$description: Light theme: deep ochre, AA on ivory (4.99:1 canvas → 5.53:1 raised).

dark.$description: Dark theme: warm amber, AA on graphite (7.82:1 canvas → 6.33:1 raised).

themes.$description: Site-safe semantic tokens, resolved per theme. The build emits themes.light → :root and themes.dark → [data-theme='dark']; the emitted CSS custom-property names are identical across themes (--color-bg-canvas, --color-text-primary, …). These are the ONLY groups (with the named theme-invariant groups) the public-site build walks (consult 0067 Q5).

light.$description: Default theme — 'Ledger': warm ivory paper, warm-ink text, ink-navy accent. Ships at launch (consult 0066: light-default, theme toggle is P1).

canvas.$description: App background — the warm ivory paper.

inset.$description: Recessed fill ON a surface/raised host — hover fills for outline/ghost controls, quiet inset note blocks. NOT a page background: bg.canvas is the page, this is a shallow well inside a card. Minted by ADR 0340 Amdt 2 to close the seven consumers that were using bg.canvas for this job (invisible under Ledger where canvas was near-white; a heavy mid-stone block under Studio).

long-form.$description: Body text in long documents (policy pages): softer ink for sustained reading; 12.16:1 on canvas.

muted.$description: Captions, timestamps, footer meta. 5.34:1 on canvas — AA at any size.

on-accent.$description: Text on the navy accent fill — white reads 9.98:1 on accent.default.

default.$description: Decorative hairlines (rules, dividers) — the Ledger row-rule.

interactive.$description: Boundaries of inputs/controls: ≥3:1 on canvas (3.68), surface (3.91), raised (4.08) per WCAG 1.4.11.

default.$description: Links, CTAs, the mark, focus. As link text: 9.01:1 on canvas — AA on all surfaces. Never a signal hue.

active.$description: Pressed state for fills/borders only — not for text.

ring.$description: 9.01:1 against canvas — exceeds the 3:1 non-text minimum.

dark.$description: Variant theme — warm graphite. The coherence bridge during the re-theme transition and the multi-monitor option (ADR 0035). Reuses + warms the prior dark prototype.

inset.$description: Recessed fill ON a surface/raised host — same role as the light counterpart, but LIGHTER than its host, because dark elevation lifts. See color.warm-graphite.820.

long-form.$description: Body text in long documents: dimmed one step to reduce glare; 12.48:1 on canvas.

muted.$description: Captions, timestamps, footer meta. 6.72:1 on canvas — AA at any size.

on-accent.$description: Text on the steel accent fill — dark reads 7.10:1 on accent.default.

interactive.$description: Boundaries of inputs/controls: ≥3:1 on canvas (4.38), surface (3.98), raised (3.54) per WCAG 1.4.11.

default.$description: Links, CTAs, the mark, focus. As link text: 7.10:1 on canvas — AA on all surfaces. Never a signal hue.

active.$description: Pressed state for fills/borders only — not for text.

ring.$description: 7.10:1 against canvas — exceeds the 3:1 non-text minimum.

serif.$description: Display family — H1/headings only, never tables or labels (ADR 0035). Self-hosted variable woff2 (consult 0067 Q4).

sans.$description: UI/body family — replaces Inter (ADR 0035). Self-hosted variable woff2.

mono.$description: Tabular figures for tickers and dense numerics in the product app — replaces the system stack (ADR 0035). Unused on the pre-launch site.

550.$description: Half-header slot — 'Your read / Ticker analysis' banners. One step below heading-1 (1.5rem), one above heading-2 (1.25rem). App-only (#34).

typography.$description: Theme-invariant. Serif (display family) is reserved for display + section headings; body/caption/legal use the sans UI family (ADR 0035).

display.$description: Hero H1, mobile-first size — Source Serif 4.

display-large.$description: Hero H1 at the desktop breakpoint — Source Serif 4.

heading-1.$description: Section head — Source Serif 4 (display register, large text ≥24px qualifies at AA 3:1).

legal.$description: Policy-page body: full 16px with relaxed leading — legal text is never set smaller than body.

half-header.$description: App-only (#34). The 'Your read / Ticker analysis' half banners — one step below heading-1, above heading-2. Source Serif 4 semibold at 1.375rem. Sits between heading-1 (1.5rem) and heading-2 (1.25rem) in the section-header scale; never used for per-section heads (those are heading-2).

elevation.$description: App-only (#34), theme-variant. Light ('Ledger') leans on hairline rules with restrained warm shadows; dark elevation is primarily surface lightening (bg.surface → bg.raised) with shadows as the secondary cue. Never on path cards — elevation difference reads as ranking (spec §6.2).

low.$description: In-flow raised elements: expanders, notices. Warm-ink ~8% over paper.

motion.$description: App-only (#34), theme-invariant. Calm: color/opacity transitions, no movement that begs attention; everything suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

fast.$description: Hover/focus color shifts, live value refreshes.

reveal.$description: Section-loader part-and-whoosh: bars sweep outward + content rises in. Between base (180ms) and slow (1200ms); the outward sweep and the vertical settle run simultaneously at this duration.

signal.$description: App-only (#34), theme-variant — a single value cannot be AA on both ivory and graphite, so positive/negative carry .light/.dark resolutions. P&L up/down — on the NUMBER only, never on chrome, cards, or paths (spec §6.2: color-grading a path reads as advice); always paired with an explicit sign — color never carries meaning alone (WCAG 1.4.1). Lives outside themes.* so the site build never emits it.

health.$description: App-only (#34), theme-variant. Data-health marker: limited / unavailable / stale / conflicting (spec §6.8 honest degradation). Deliberately neither a signal hue nor the accent. Lives outside themes.* so the site build never emits it.

path-card.$description: Component tokens for the symmetric path menu (read-components.md). One set of values for ALL path cards — uniformity enforced at the token layer; a 'featured' variant cannot exist without a reviewable change here (spec §6.2). App-only (#34). Color bindings are theme-variant (.light/.dark) because the semantic tokens they mirror moved under themes.*; structural/typographic tokens (radius, padding, fonts, gap) are theme-invariant. Lives outside themes.* so the site build never emits it.

state-field.$description: ADR 0026 state-interaction field — one binding for ALL path cards (R5 gate #2 visual parity, consult 0051). Quiet secondary-text register; references only text.muted/text.secondary so signal.*/accent.*/text.primary are UNREACHABLE through this binding. Holds in the degraded render (N/A '—' in this same body style).
Dark resolution of the ADR 0026 state-interaction field — same parity + no-signal-color-reachable guarantees as light.
Theme-invariant typography for the state-interaction field (colors are under path-card.light/.dark.state-field).

accent-surface.$description: App-only (#34). The RESERVED standout for the Paths · Outlook pair — the two sections that are identical-treatment by design (ADR 0008, clause 2: pair-symmetric; the decision menu and the conclusion get the same accent surface so neither outranks the other). Applied to: fast-cut pills, section containers (Paths section + Outlook box), section-header markers, and popovers. NEVER used for any other surface — 'reserved for the pair' is literal. Kept DISTINCT from themes.*.accent.* (links/CTAs) per ADR 0008: the standout surface must never read as 'just another link.' Theme-variant (.light/.dark) because the underlying primitives differ between themes.

pill.$description: Fast-cut pill fill — slightly deeper than the container so the parked pill reads as a control, not a section. #DFE6F0. 4.23:1 on canvas — AA non-text (WCAG 1.4.11).

container.$description: Paths section + Outlook box fill — the pale navy wash. #E9EDF3. IDENTICAL on both halves; pair-symmetry is enforced by sharing this one token.

border.$description: Container border + pill border. Reuses accent.default — visually consistent, and the border carries the accent identity without a new hue. #23436F. AA non-text on the container fill (9.01:1 on canvas).

marker.$description: Section-header accent marker (a left-edge rule or a small indicator at the heading level) + horizon-label text (NEAR / MID / FAR) inside the Outlook box. #23436F. 9.01:1 on container fill — AA body text.

rule.$description: Hairline rule inside the container (e.g. the Outlook box divider above the non-personalization line). Light, stays in the wash family. #DFE6F0.

on-surface.$description: Primary text on the container fill. Reuses text.primary — #211D17 reads 13.84:1 on the container fill, AAA.

on-surface-muted.$description: Muted text on the container fill (label-line captions, non-personalization line). #6B6358 reads 4.68:1 on the container fill — AA at any size.

pill.$description: Fast-cut pill fill — navy-lift, slightly deeper than the container. #233152.

container.$description: Paths section + Outlook box fill — navy-lift on graphite. #1C2A45. IDENTICAL on both halves; pair-symmetry enforced by this single token.

border.$description: Container border + pill border. Reuses dark accent.default. #7DA6DB. AA non-text on container fill.

marker.$description: Header marker + horizon-label text (NEAR / MID / FAR). #9BBCE6. 7.82:1 on container fill — AA body text.

rule.$description: Hairline rule inside the dark container. #233152.

on-surface.$description: Primary text on dark container fill. #F4F0E8. 13.91:1 on container fill — AAA.

on-surface-muted.$description: Muted text on dark container fill. #C6BEAD. 7.38:1 on container fill — AA at any size.

surface.$description: App-only (#34). Named surfaces that are not bg.canvas/surface/raised — structural zones with their own identity. Theme-variant.

panel.$description: The impersonal-half band ('Ticker analysis'): a full-bleed tinted surface that makes the embedded publication visible as a distinct zone. Slightly warmer/cooler than canvas but not as deep as bg.surface, so it reads as a section of the page, not a card.

light.$description: Warm parchment — one step warmer than canvas (#F7F3EA), conveying the panel as printed matter set into the page. Contrast with text.primary on canvas: the panel is a zone, not an overlay.

dark.$description: Deep warm graphite — slightly darker than canvas (#1A1713), receding to mark the publication boundary. The panel is a darker zone in dark mode (inverted logic from light — depth = distinction).

text-link.$description: App-only (#34). Inline link and @-handle text color — kept DISTINCT from themes.*.accent.default and from accent-surface.*.marker per ADR 0008 clause 2: 'reserved for the pair' stays literally true. A link uses accent.default (navy/steel); text-link is a slightly different value so a reader never confuses an inline hyperlink with the pair's standout surface. Theme-variant.

light.$description: Inline link / @-handle on light surfaces. #2F5C97 — slightly brighter than accent.default (#23436F), still clearly in the navy family. 7.41:1 on canvas — AA on all surfaces including bg.raised.

dark.$description: Inline link / @-handle on dark surfaces. #8FB4E4 — slightly distinct from accent.default (#7DA6DB). 8.28:1 on canvas — AA on all surfaces.

layer.$description: Theme-invariant z-index scale (ADR 0570) — mints a named vocabulary for the five ad-hoc z-index literals in twiceover-app, values numerically identical to what already shipped (pure rename, zero behavior change). The `raised` tier ties three semantically distinct consumers (an in-page floating pair, static app chrome, a transient dropdown) by accident of who picked which number first — a known naming tension, not resolved here (see consult 0571).

raised.$description: In-flow/fixed chrome competing in the root stacking context: FastCutPair's floating pill, the masthead account-menu disclosure, the installed-context tab bar.

popover.$description: A transient overlay anchored to its trigger: FastCutPair's popover.

overlay.$description: A full-viewport modal overlay: the re-auth overlay.
